400_bad_request_errors.description: Invalid email format provided. Please provide a valid RFC 5322 compliant email address.
Invalid phone number format. SMS notifications require a valid Spanish phone number in format +34XXXXXXXXX starting with 6 or 7.
Missing required field: 'message'. All notifications must include a message content.
Invalid notification type. Supported types are: EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP.
E.164 format required for WhatsApp. Please provide a phone number starting with + followed by country code and number.

404_not_found_errors.description: The notification endpoint /api/v1/notifications was not found on the server.
The requested notification with ID 'abc123def456' does not exist in the system.
No notifications matching the specified query filters were found.

500_internal_server_error.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing your notification. Please try again later.
Database connection failed. The notification could not be stored at this time.
Failed to send notification through EMAIL channel: SMTP server unavailable.
Failed to send notification through SMS channel: SMS gateway unreachable.

503_service_unavailable.description: The notification service is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few moments.
The backend service is undergoing scheduled maintenance. We'll be back online shortly.
Too many requests. The server is temporarily overwhelmed. Please retry your request later.
Email service provider is currently unavailable. Notifications cannot be sent at this time.

malformed_error_responses.message: Incomplete error response without description field.
